scope: Continue v23 demo refinement after actual source-overlay QA found false hardware outside the partial semantic labels
training_population: All181 demo frames; no independent validation or test
labels: Immutable v12 semantic masks plus source-reviewed class-exclusion masks. Class exclusion does not label unmeasured ground as free.
extra_loss: 2*(-log(1-p_rock)) on reviewed not-rock interiors;4*(-log(1-p_hardware)) on reviewed not-hardware source pixels
selection: Retain all179 manual-region proxies found by stage1, at most0.005 absolute stage1 rock pixel recall loss; maximize original objective minus0.5 false-hardware fraction on Navcam exclusions minus0.25 false-rock fraction on clear-flat exclusions
zero_error_goal: Try for zero reviewed class-exclusion violations; report any remaining pixels without claiming full-image perfection
release_policy: v23 remains rejected despite aggregate metric gains. Keep original v11 installed until the corrected actual model passes every check.
